about.meta.description.message: Learn about Fold Craft Launcher: an open-source Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Android built by FCL-Team and the community.

about.desc.message: A free, open-source launcher that brings Minecraft: Java Edition to Android — built by FCL-Team and contributors around the world.

about.lead1.message: Fold Craft Launcher (FCL) started as a way to run Minecraft: Java Edition on Android without a PC. It pairs the launcher core of HMCL with the Amethyst-Android game backend, so phones and tablets can launch the real Java game — mods, shaders and all.

about.lead2.message: FCL is free software released under the GPL-3.0 license. The code, the documentation and the translations are all open: anyone can inspect it, improve it and share it.

about.lead3.message: The project is developed by FCL-Team together with the community. Translations are managed on Weblate and the documentation lives in the FCL-Docs repository.

about.stats.note.message: Counted from the public GitHub repository and release assets.

about.foundation.sub.message: FCL would not exist without the projects below. Huge thanks to their maintainers and contributors.

about.foundation.hmcl.message: The launcher core: version management, downloads and launcher logic are ported from HMCL.

about.foundation.amethyst.message: The Android game backend that starts the JVM and renders Minecraft on mobile devices.

about.foundation.openjdk.message: Multi-architecture Java runtimes built and released by FCL-Team for every supported device.

about.foundation.terracotta.message: Peer-to-peer networking for LAN play between devices, wrapped by the Terracotta module.

about.team.sub.message: Code, documentation, translations, controller layouts and bug reports — FCL is the work of many hands.

about.credits.sub.message: FCL builds on and works together with these projects. The full dependency list lives in the repository README.

about.license.desc.message: Fold Craft Launcher is distributed under the GNU General Public License v3. Read the license and the end-user agreement to learn what that means for you.

community.meta.description.message: Join the Fold Craft Launcher community on Discord and QQ, report bugs on GitHub, help translate FCL and support development.

community.desc.message: FCL is built by volunteers and shaped by the people who play it. Ask questions, share your setups, report bugs or help translate the launcher.

community.discord.desc.message: The main international community: support, modding talk and release news.

community.qq.desc.message: The Chinese-speaking community. Search for group 762054349 in QQ to join.

community.github.desc.message: Report bugs, request features, browse the source or open a pull request.

community.weblate.desc.message: Translate FCL into your language in the browser — no tools required.

community.docs.desc.message: Guides for accounts, custom controls, building from source and contributing.

community.sponsor.desc.message: Support the developers with a one-off or recurring donation on Afdian.

community.help.sub.message: A little information goes a long way. These four habits get your question answered much faster.

community.help.tip1.message: Check the documentation and search existing issues before posting.

community.help.tip2.message: Include your FCL version, device model and Android version.

community.help.tip3.message: Attach the launcher log — it is the fastest way to find the cause.

community.help.tip4.message: Be patient and kind. Everyone here is a volunteer.

community.bugs.desc.message: The issue tracker is the best place for reproducible problems. Search first, then open a new issue with your log attached.

download.meta.description.message: Download the latest Fold Craft Launcher APK for Android. Choose the build for your device, read the release notes and start playing.

download.desc.message: The latest stable release, built for Android 8.0 and newer. Pick the package that matches your device — or grab the universal build if you are not sure.

download.install.step1.message: Download the APK that matches your device and open the file.

download.install.step2.message: If Android asks, allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps, then confirm the installation.

download.install.step3.message: Open FCL and add an account — Microsoft, offline, or a third-party authentication server.

download.install.step4.message: Download a Minecraft version, adjust the renderer and controls, then press play.

download.history.desc.message: Looking for an older build? Every release stays available on GitHub.

download.disclaimer.message: Fold Craft Launcher is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB.

home.meta.description.message: Fold Craft Launcher is a free, open-source Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Android. Play every version with mods, shaders and fully customizable touch controls.

home.community.desc.message: Get help, share your setups, report bugs and help translate FCL into your language.

home.features.sub.message: A full-featured launcher built for touch screens — and for people who like to tinker.

home.features.versions.desc.message: From Alpha and Beta snapshots to the newest release — switch versions in a single tap.

home.features.loaders.desc.message: Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, Quilt, LiteLoader, OptiFine and Cleanroom are supported out of the box.

home.features.java.desc.message: Java 8, 17, 21 and 25 runtimes are bundled for every architecture — and you can import your own.

home.features.controls.desc.message: Virtual mouse, fully customizable controller layouts, and automatic conversion of ZalithLauncher 2 layouts.

home.features.shaders.desc.message: Run shaders with VirGL, Zink or MobileGlues and get the best performance your device can offer.

home.features.resources.desc.message: Download and organize mods, modpacks, resource packs, shaders and worlds without leaving the launcher.

home.features.themes.desc.message: Custom backgrounds and color schemes, plus a plugin system for renderers and drivers.

home.features.opensource.desc.message: GPL-3.0 licensed, developed in the open by FCL-Team and a community of contributors.

home.hero.tagline.message: Minecraft: Java Edition on your Android device

home.hero.desc.message: FCL is a free, open-source launcher that runs every version of Minecraft: Java Edition on Android — with your favorite mods, shaders, custom controls and a theme that feels like home.

home.hero.note.message: Free and open source · GPL-3.0 · Built by FCL-Team and contributors
